correctness.rationale: For any n,d, a one-part collector visits new labels with probability 1-(j/n)^d at count j, giving independent positive geometric waiting stages. Greedy offered-unseen choice stochastically maximizes each part count on K_{a,b} by monotone one-step coupling. Deterministic alternation gives exact parity formulas. Log-concavity and TP2 convolution prove U_a >=_lr U_b, and the support difference makes even-time inequalities strict for k>=a-1. The exact mean identity follows by comparing maxima of independent stage totals. Exact checker passed 704 independent labeled-walk CDF equalities, 160 odd parity identities, 2564 strict even tests and 513 LR minors. The analytic steps, not finite experiments, prove the infinite quantifiers.

value.rationale: The limited-offer controlled-walk cover-time problem is generally difficult, but on all K_{a,b} a single feedback rule optimizes the entire deadline law. The parity-resolved strict stochastic start-side comparison and <=1-step expectation bound sharpen crude cover-time estimates. The independent all-size likelihood-ratio ordering of nonlinear coupon-collection sums is a structural comparison, not a routine one-point numerical evaluation.
